name: Clay
thesis: A reading room shaped by warm clay, rounded serif lettering, and the unhurried pleasure of a small independent bookshop.
difference: Dusty terracotta fills the entire canvas; aubergine Fraunces headlines and Newsreader text sit directly on the material. An arched photograph anchors the centered brief, a dark rounded reading control gives it one clear destination, and a soft floating navigation tray gathers the quieter tools.
tradeoff: The warmer material and sculpted photographs create a stronger personality, but are less neutral than a paper-toned reader; the image crop also favors atmosphere over seeing every edge of a photograph.
lens: A contemporary ceramics and independent bookshop art director translating tactile joy into a native iPhone reading app.
